content: Malik al-Shuʿarāʾ Bahār reports that the printed Ḥabīb al-Siyar of Khwāndamīr gives 830 for the death but a manuscript in his possession gives 836; Melvin-Koushki says news of a death two weeks before the end of 835 would probably reach Fars only in the following year, and that 830 is certainly wrong because Ibn Turka wrote works after that date (R. Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī, R. Mabdaʾ u Maʿād).
